h1: Storm & Hail Damage Roof Repair in McAllen, TX
lede: Edel Roofing & Construction inspects and repairs hail and wind damage on McAllen homes and businesses. We document what we find in writing with photos, and we tell you when damage is only cosmetic.

sections.title: McAllen's recent storm record
paras: The National Weather Service has recorded three notable storms in McAllen since 2023, through local storm reports and damage surveys:

April 21, 2023: hail up to 1.25 inches reported in the city. April 28, 2023: a 74 mph wind gust. The NWS damage survey found a building on S 29th St that lost more than half of its shingles. May 8, 2025: hail up to 2 inches in north McAllen and a microburst with winds estimated at 80 to 85 mph between Taylor Rd and Ware Rd.

The May 2025 storm is the one most homeowners remember. The NWS survey found several dozen damaged homes in the microburst area, with at least three showing partial shingle lift. That kind of damage is easy to miss, because the shingles settle back down after the wind stops.

sections.title: What we check after a McAllen storm

cards.title: Hail bruises
cards.body: Soft spots and missing granules where hail hit. We check every slope, including the back of the house.

cards.title: Broken shingle seals
cards.body: Shingles that lifted in the wind and lost their seal, even if they look flat now.

cards.title: Flashing and vents
cards.body: Bent flashing, loose vent caps, and cracked pipe boots that start leaking weeks later.

cards.title: Gutters and screens
cards.body: Dents in gutters, downspouts, and window screens help show the size and direction of the hail.

cards.title: Flat roof edges
cards.body: On commercial roofs, wind lifted membrane at the edges and punctures from hail.

cards.title: Photos and a written report
cards.body: Everything we find, documented for your insurance company.

sections.title: Filing a claim the right way
paras: Call your insurance company soon after the storm and check your policy for any deadline on filing. The Texas Department of Insurance gives a few rules to follow: get more than one bid, check references, and do not pay in full up front. TDI also says waiving a homeowners deductible is illegal under Texas law, so an offer to "cover your deductible" is a red flag.

We inspect, document, and give you a written estimate. We are not a public adjuster and we do not negotiate your claim. If the damage is cosmetic and does not affect how the roof works, we say so. We are not paid more for finding damage that is not there.

faqs.q: My roof was in the May 2025 storm but nothing leaks. Should I still check it?
faqs.a: Yes. Broken shingle seals and hail bruises often take months to turn into a leak. An inspection now gives you a record of the damage while it is still clearly tied to that storm.

faqs.q: How do I know if it was hail or just age?
faqs.a: Hail leaves round bruises and fresh granule loss in a random pattern, and it usually marks gutters, vents, and screens too. Age wear is even across the roof. We show you photos of what we see so you can tell the difference.

faqs.q: Does storm damage mean I need a new roof?
faqs.a: No. Many storm jobs are a repair: a few shingles, some flashing, a new vent boot. Replacement makes sense when the damage covers a large part of the roof or the roof was already near the end. See roof repair in McAllen.

faqs.q: Can you meet my insurance adjuster?
faqs.a: We can share our written report and photos with you to give to your adjuster. The claim itself is between you and your insurance company.

faqs.q: How do I get a storm damage inspection in McAllen?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. Inspections are free with no obligation.
